Leak write-ups are generated by Claude. They run automatically if this page is opened inside a Claude Artifact. To enable them in your local copy, paste an Anthropic API key below — it is stored only in this browser on your machine and is sent only to Anthropic. Everything else (logging, replay, the Leaks panel) works without a key.
Model used for per-hand analysis and batch grading. Defaults to Opus for the deepest reads — this needs your own API key (set above), since the keyless in-Artifact path only supports Sonnet. Swap in a Sonnet model here if you want faster, cheaper analysis.
Grading engine. Rules is a deterministic offline grader built from the same exploitative playbook (heuristic thresholds, honest about what it can't judge); AI needs a key; the hybrid runs rules and sends only the flagged "above the flowchart" hands to the AI.
